products.name: Camel Merino Real Leather Coat
products.shortDescription: A luxurious camel-colored genuine cow leather coat featuring a soft Merino wool collar and lining. Designed with a button-front closure
products.description:
Crafted from premium genuine cow leather with a sophisticated suede finish.



Features a luxurious Merino wool collar for exceptional softness and warmth.



Soft Merino wool details along the inner front opening and sleeve cuffs provide additional insulation.



Classic button-front closure offers an elegant and practical finish.



Two spacious front patch pockets combine functionality with timeless design.



Relaxed silhouette provides comfortable layering during colder seasons.



Premium craftsmanship combines durability, warmth, and sophisticated styling.



Perfect for elegant casual outfits and winter wardrobes.
